strings.할 말이 있어서 급하게 불렀어. 미안해, 잠깐 기다려줄래? 지금 하려고: I called you urgently because there's something to discuss. Sorry, could you wait a moment? There's something I need to do first.
strings.모른 척하려고 했지만, 어쩔 수 없었어요. 게르다의 대표로서 한 가지 행: I tried to overlook it, but I can't. As Gerda's representative, there is one thing I must do.
So I would like your permission, Feta.
What? What do you...? I don't mind. Do as you wish, Lady Io.
Then I'll take that as your consent.
strings.(이오가 손을 들어 페타의 뺨을 때린다.): (Io raises her hand and slaps Feta.)
strings.페타, %s에게 사과하세요. 그리고 저와 게르다의 모든 존재에게도 사과하: Feta, apologize to %s. And apologize to me and everyone in Gerda.
strings.당신은 마녀에 대해 알고 있었어요. 그리고 나 같은 사람이 마녀에 대해: You knew about the witch. And you must have realized that someone like me knew about witches too.
Even if your arrival in Gerda was no coincidence, you should at least have told us.
strings.당신의 목숨을 넘어 우리 모두가 위험해질 수 있었는데…. 왜 아무 말도: More than your own life, all of us could have been endangered... Why did you say nothing? Feta, you aren't such a foolish mage.
strings.제가 생각이 짧았어요. 그저 모험가님을 만나 그것만 전해드리고 싶어서 타: I didn't think it through. I only wanted to meet the adventurer and deliver it, so I was waiting for the right moment...
But you both kept leaving so quickly that I never had a chance to speak.
Did we? A poor excuse for a gifted mage, but I'll believe you.
strings.아마도 당신은 믿음이 없었겠죠. 적어도 우리가 당신을 도와줄 거란…. 그: Perhaps you lacked faith. At least, faith that we would help you... So you simply watched and waited.
strings.며칠 내에 게르다를 떠나세요. 아니, 정확히 말하자면 프레이오스로 돌아가: Leave Gerda within a few days. No, more precisely, return to Freios.
strings.이제 곧 위험한 날이 이스트랜드에 와요. 당신의 마력이 그 자가 원하는: A dangerous day will soon come to Eastland. Your mana could become a sacrifice to the binding that man desires.
Lady Io, I'm sorry. I made a mistake.
I can see you're sincere, so I forgive you. Thanks to you, we were able to judge the timing somewhat.
This isn't a matter for you to involve yourself in. Step back now. Farewell.
strings.(페타가 더는 상대해주지 않을 것 같은 이오의 모습을 바라본다. 잠시 후: (Feta looks at Io, who seems unwilling to speak further. After a moment, he nods in understanding and leaves.)
strings.미안해, 오래 기다렸지?: Sorry. Have you been waiting long?
strings.이런 일이 내키진 않지만, 가끔 해야 할 필요가 있어. 그리고, 페타를: I don't enjoy doing that, but sometimes it's necessary. And Feta will need watching.
You don't have to do it yourself. One of Dayna's subordinates, I think? They seem capable enough...
strings.대충은 알아. 이 이야긴 됐고, 본론을 말할게. 얼마 지나지 않아 바이스: Roughly. Enough of that. I'll get to the point. Before long, Weiss will summon Deimos.
strings.그러기 전에 데보라 설원에 봉인된 길을 열려고 해. 봉인을 푸는 일은 결: Before that, I mean to open a sealed path in the Debora Snowfields. Breaking the seal will be no easy task.
strings.속박의 힘이 설원으로 퍼지지 않도록 해야 하고, 임시 기지로 사용할 공간: We need to keep binding from spreading into the snowfields and create a space to use as a temporary base.
Only then can we go to Avalon.
There's something I need to do in the meantime.
strings.속박이 생명의 힘을 바꿔 만든 것이니까, 똑같진 않더라도 그 정도를 버틸: Binding is transformed life force. Even if it isn't the same kind of power, we'll need enough mana to withstand it.
strings.이스트랜드엔 대표적인 마법사 집단이라고 해봐야 쥬얼 학파 정도야. 루맨에: The only major group of mages in Eastland is the Jewel School. Only a few remain in Lumen. Even with all their strength, I don't know how long they could hold...
strings.제가 메디아 님이 가지고 있는 힘의 흔적을 받으면 어떻게든 되지 않을까요: If I receive the trace of Lady Medea's power, couldn't we manage somehow?
strings.메디아 양의 힘이 어느 정도인지 내가 알 수 없어서…. 일단 부족할 것: I don't know how much power Medea has... But I think it will still fall short. Lady Iris is worried too.
Have you forgotten? I've been receiving messages from the goddess longer than you have, %s.
Our conversation has frozen solid. Let's break through and move on.
strings.실바리아 제국은 신들의 황혼이 있었던 땅이니까 신이 찾아오는 시기를 미룰: The Silvaria Empire stands on land that witnessed the twilight of the gods. There should be a way to delay a god's arrival there.
strings.이미 실바리아 제국에서도 알고 있을지도 모르겠어. 거기 황제에게 예지 능: They may already know about it. Their empress has the gift of foresight, doesn't she...?
The Alliance of Light has explained the situation and sent a letter to the Silvaria Empire. They'll have ample reason to help.
%s, I want you to go and find a way. See Medea first. She may point you in the right direction.
strings.(이오가 오자마자 게르다를 떠나는 %s의 뒷모습을 빤히 바라본다.): (Io watches %s leave Gerda almost as soon as the adventurer arrived.)
Even for %s, the goddess's messenger, this won't be easy...
strings.그나저나 아가슈라는 대체 거기서 뭘 하고 있었던 거지? 분명 누가 또 있: But what was an Agasura doing there? I'm sure someone else was there too...
I don't know what to say. Why do you...
I will tell you where I stand when you return. And...
For this matter, you will have to go there, whether you like it or not.
strings.그곳에 '힘'이 머무르고 있어요. 신의 힘인지, 마녀의 힘인지, 아가슈라: A 'power' resides there. I cannot tell whether it belongs to a god, a witch, or an Agasura...
But I believe what you obtain there could make things difficult for Weiss...
I don't know what sort of place it is, but I'll go.
I pray that nothing happens to you.
strings.저, 메디아 님? 왜 다시는 못 볼 사람처럼 말씀하세요?: Lady Medea? Why are you speaking as though we'll never meet again?
Am I? This is simply how I speak...
Whether you like it or not, you will have to keep coming to see me...
strings.후우, 어차피 당신에겐 저희 마을에 걸려있는 결계도 통하지 않고 있으니…: Whew. The barrier around our village doesn't work on you anyway...
Go straight to Sir Ziskad. He will tell you where to go.
I will. But will he be in Lumen? He's often away...
I believe he went to see his sister.
strings.(메디아가 들고 있던 지팡이로 살며시 %s의 어깨를 두드린다.): (Medea gently taps %s on the shoulder with her staff.)
strings.(그때처럼 어깨를 두드려 주시네….): (She's tapping my shoulder like she did before...)
strings.네, 너무 걱정하지 마세요. 별일 없을 거예요. 다녀올게요!: I will. Don't worry too much. Everything will be fine. I'll be back!
strings.(호숫가 앞이라…. 제나는 잘 있을까?): (By the lakeshore... I wonder how Jenna is doing.)
strings.(지스크 영지의 한적한 호숫가 한편에서 아름다운 멜로디를 품은 노랫소리가: (A lovely melody drifts from a quiet stretch of lakeshore in Zisk Territory.)
strings.(전보다 맑고 고운 목소리가 힘을 잃지 않고 잔잔한 호숫가의 수면 위로: (Clearer and sweeter than before, the steady voice flows across the calm surface of the lake.)
I'll smile a little at a time. ♬ If I keep smiling, the smile will become my own.
strings.그래도 어색한 건 어쩔 수 없어요♬: Even so, I can't help feeling awkward. ♬
strings.연못에 비친 모습이 보이진 않지만…, 그게 전부는 아니죠♪: I can't see my reflection in the pond... But that isn't everything. ♪
strings.(제나가 갑자기 들려오는 박수 소리에 놀라 뒤를 돌아본다.): (Startled by sudden applause, Jenna turns around.)
%s, you're here? I heard clapping so suddenly, I thought a ghost had come.
strings.아, 정말 너무 좋은 노래라서 저도 모르게…. 혹시 놀랐어요?: Oh, your song was so lovely that I couldn't help myself... Did I startle you?
strings.조금 놀라긴 했지만, 괜찮아요. 혹시 무슨 일로 오셨나요? 오라버니를 만: A little, but it's all right. What brings you here? Did you come to see my brother?
Yes. I heard Sir Ziskad would be here.
strings.이거 어쩌죠? 오라버니는 기다리다가 일이 생겼다고 방금 전에 서둘러 돌아: Oh, dear. He was waiting, but something came up and he hurried back just now. I'll give you his message instead.
Oh, really? Then please tell me.
Ahem. One, two, three... 'Ah, you've come.'
strings.제나, 그거 지스카드 님 흉내…?: Jenna, is that an impression of Sir Ziskad...?
Does it sound awkward? I did practice... Maybe I shouldn't. Please keep listening.
My brother said you might already know this person and should go see her. An elven mage famous in the Silvaria Empire...
strings.오라버니께서 실바리아 제국과의 관계를 돈독히 해야 한다고 하셨거든요. 제: He said we need to strengthen our relationship with the Silvaria Empire. The empress has been quite friendly toward us...
And apparently there are some unexpected connections between them...
strings.그 엘프 마법사는 어떤 분이신가요?: What is that elven mage like?
Unusual and fun. She likes delicious desserts too.
I'd love to meet her if I have the chance.
strings.그럴 수 있겠죠? 이건 다 가이아 님의 은혜…. 언제나 감사드리고 있어요: Do you think so? It's all thanks to Lady Gaia's grace... I'm always grateful.
strings.(제나의 표정이 전보다 좋아진 것 같아….): (Jenna looks happier than she used to...)
I wish I could help you and my brother too, %s...
It's all right. Just being here already gives Sir Ziskad so much strength.
strings.(지스크 영지를 떠나려 하는 순간, 누군가 %s의 손을 붙잡는다.): (Just as %s is about to leave Zisk Territory, someone takes the adventurer's hand.)
strings.(이리스라는 말에 뒤를 돌아보니 신탁의 방에서 봤었던 이리스가 환하게 웃: (At the mention of Iris, the adventurer turns to see her smiling brightly, as she appeared in the Chamber of Revelation.)
strings.제나, 오랜만인데 이렇게 나타나서 미안해요. 제가 모험가님을 모셔가도 괜: Jenna, it's been a while. I'm sorry to appear so suddenly. May I borrow the adventurer?
strings.갈게. 나한테 하고 싶은 이야기가 있어서잖아. 그런데 어디로 가?: I'll come. You have something to tell me, right? Where are we going?
Keep holding my hand and close your eyes.
strings.(이리스의 말이 끝나자마자 이리스의 손끝에서 신비한 빛이 흘러나와 두 사: (As Iris finishes speaking, a mysterious light flows from her fingertips and envelops them both.)
She left the lakeshore a gift of beautiful light.
I should finish singing. Something to sing for Ell when she comes...
Why have the Algae stopped moving? They were moving perfectly well a moment ago...
Oh... So that's why my brother left in such a hurry...
I'm fine. If we hadn't come here immediately, it would have been dangerous.
Zisk Territory is slowly being consumed.
strings.제 힘이 거기까지 미치지 않아서 정확한 건 알 수 없어요. 하지만, 불길: My power doesn't reach that far, so I can't know for certain. But an ominous power is flowing out of Avalon.
strings.그동안 아발론에서는 어떤 조짐도 보이지 않았는데…. 지금 그곳을 가득 채: There had been no signs from Avalon until now... But the power filling it has overflowed into Zisk Territory.
strings.지스카드 님은 서둘러 그 힘을 막기 위해 움직이셨고, 저에게 당신을 부탁: Sir Ziskad hurried to stop it and asked me to take care of you.
Lady Io and Lady Medea are sorry. They didn't know this would happen.
I'm fine, but you put yourself in danger.
It's all right. I can endure that much. I have to.
Jenna is safe. That power only affects living beings.
Oh, there's no time to stand around. I have to hurry.
strings.저는 저대로 계속해서 아발론에서 흐르는 불길한 힘이 다른 곳으로 퍼지지: I'll keep focusing on preventing the ominous power flowing from Avalon from spreading elsewhere.
I say this all the time, but thank you. And I'm sorry.
You're going to meet Lady Soleil, right? I'll send you there.
strings.아, 이리스. 혹시 나에게 메시지를 보낸 마녀에 대해 뭔가 알고 있어?: Oh, Iris. Do you know anything about the witch who sent me a message?
strings.제가 신격에 오르고 알게 된 것은 이 세계의 최근 일들뿐이에요. 그래서: Since ascending to divinity, I've only learned of this world's recent events. So I don't have much information about witches.
strings.마녀들은 모두가 알고 있는 것보다 오래 이 세계에 있었고, 데이모스의 일: The witches have been in this world longer than anyone realizes. They seem to be waiting for what comes after the matter of Deimos.
Waiting? Deimos appearing wouldn't be good for them...
I'll tell you as soon as I learn more.
I'll look into it too. Right now, stopping Deimos matters more than the witches.
Yes. Give me your hand and close your eyes.
strings.저번에도 말씀드렸듯이 제 힘이 닿는 한, 마음이 있는 한 당신을 위한 일: As I said before, as long as my power can reach you and I have this heart, I'll act for you. And I'll be here for everyone who has cherished me.
strings.그러니까 너무 무리하진 마세요. 아셨죠?: So don't push yourself too hard. All right?
strings.(%s의 말이 끝나자마자 이리스가 손을 붙잡는다.): (As soon as %s finishes speaking, Iris takes the adventurer's hand.)
strings.(이 온기가 마치 이리스가 날 믿는 것 같이 느껴져….): (That warmth feels like Iris's faith in me...)
I made it to the right place.
Lie here for a moment. I'll bring the healing magic teacher.
Yes. I feel much better now, thanks to you.
What a relief. The impact must have been worse than I thought.
strings.제가 글래스턴에 다녀오는 길이었거든요. 하늘에서 쿵, 하고 뭔가 떨어져: I was on my way back from Glaston. Something fell out of the sky with a thud, and we had a traffic accident.
strings.페이브리스가 덥석 물고 흔드는 걸 보니까 사람인 것 같아서 일단 뱉어보라: Feybris grabbed it in his jaws and shook it. It looked like a person, so I told him to spit it out.
When I looked, it was you, Adventurer.
strings.제가 하늘에서 떨어져요?, 마침 저 괴물을 타고 가던 소레이유와 부딪혔다: I fell out of the sky? And collided with you riding that monster?
It's hard to believe, but it's true.
strings.(소레이유의 뒤에서 머리 셋 달린 늑대인지 개인지 알 수 없는 괴물이 으: (Behind Soleil, a three-headed monster, neither clearly wolf nor dog, growls and barks.)
You startled me! That's a Cerberus!
strings.아니에요. 페이브리스랍니다. 먹이도 줬고, 산책도 시켜줬는데 뭐가 불만인: No, it's Feybris. I fed him and took him for a walk, so I don't know what he's unhappy about...
Here, take this. It's pet jerky from Lumen.
strings.(페이브리스가 냉큼 달려와 육포를 물고 간다. 맛있게 먹다가 한두 번씩: (Feybris eagerly runs over and takes the jerky. As he eats, he occasionally gives Soleil a chilly look.)
strings.…저 녀석이 저런 표정을 짓는 건 처음이네요. 문득 제가 저 녀석처럼 변: ...I've never seen him make that face. Suddenly, I'm remembering when I turned into something like him. How embarrassing.
You were quite fierce then, Soleil.
strings.자, 페이브리스, 조심해서 돌아가. 료스알프든지 도크알프든지 원하는 대로: Now, Feybris, get home safely. Ljosalf or Dokkalf, whichever you like.
strings.(페이브리스가 고개를 끄덕이고는 힘차게 하늘 위로 날아오른다. 그러더니: (Feybris nods and soars into the sky. He races into a white cloud and disappears.)
strings.그러면 모험가님. 제가 도와드릴게…. 어, 이 바람은 뭐지?: Then, Adventurer, I can help you... Huh, what's this wind?
strings.(어디선가 불어오는 바람에 익숙한 누군가의 목소리가 실려 %s에게 다가온: (A familiar voice rides an unexpected breeze toward %s.)
strings.(%s, 미안해요. 소레이유 님 앞에 데려다준다고 했는데 그만…. 소레이: (%s, I'm sorry. I said I'd take you to Lady Soleil, but... I didn't know she'd be in the sky riding Feybris.)
It's all right, Iris. These things happen. It's your first time, so you're still getting used to it. It's fine...
Oh, she didn't come in person. She sent me a message.
Then I'll tell you what I've prepared for you.
strings.폐하께서는 지스카드 님이 요청을 하기 전에 먼저 저에게 데이모스 관련 정: Even before Sir Ziskad sent his request, Her Majesty told me to gather information about Deimos.
strings.…폐하는 어떻게 초인들보다 먼저 준비할 수 있었던 거죠?: ...How could Her Majesty prepare before the Champions did?
...I can't tell you anything about that. I don't really know...
strings.하여튼, 벨파 도서관의 사서분들과 함께 데이모스의 강림을 늦출 수 있는: Anyway, with the librarians at Belpha Library, I learned of an object that could delay Deimos's arrival.
strings.황혼 시절이 지나고, 신들이 세계를 떠나려 했을 때, 남으려 했던 어떤: After the age of twilight, when the gods tried to leave this world, some beings who wished to remain tried to stop them.
strings.그래서 필요한 걸 찾았죠. 소멸한 신들 말고, 일부의 형상만 남았던 죽은: They found what they needed: the remains of dead gods whose forms partly survived, rather than gods who had been completely annihilated.
strings.그래서 떠나는 자들을 붙잡을 물건을 만들었는데, 신들의 분노가 남아있었다: They made an object to hold back those who were leaving. But the gods' anger remained within it.
strings.분노를 삼키던 이름 없는 신들의 힘은 심장처럼 뛰기 시작했고, 그 힘은: The power of the nameless gods, absorbing that anger, began to beat like a heart. Then it rushed toward the Demon King.
strings.마왕은 그 힘에 영향을 받지 않았어요. 오히려 자신을 죽이려는 신들에게: The Demon King was unaffected. Instead, it turned the power back upon the gods who had tried to kill it.
strings.떠나는 자들을 붙잡으려고 했던 힘은 남아있던 신들에게로 다가가 수명을 삼: The power meant to hold back the departing gods struck those who remained, devoured their lifespans, and fell somewhere.
strings.그래서 그 물건이 삼킨 신의 수명, 그 힘이 있으면 데이모스가 강림하려는: So we believe that the divine lifespan it absorbed, that power, could slightly delay the moment of Deimos's descent.
strings.그런 물건이 대체 어디 있다는 거죠?: Where could such an object be?
strings.수인제국 크리드의 크노소스로 보고 있어요. 엘 아노르 평원 서부 너머에: We believe it's in Knossos, in the Beastman Empire of Creed. Beyond the western El Anoir Plains.
strings.수인들은 그곳에 성스러운 물건이 있다고 믿고 있어요. 혼돈의 하늘 당시,: The beastmen believe a sacred object is there. They say it exploded during the Sky of Chaos and drove their enemies away...
I don't know whether that's true, but it's worth investigating.
strings.고마워요, 소레이유. 제가 거기 가볼게요. 왠지 그곳에 원하는 답이 있을: Thank you, Soleil. I'll go there. Somehow, I feel the answer we need is waiting...
strings.안에 제국 유격병들이 있을 거예요. 폐하께서 출입을 허가하셨으니까 말씀하: There should be imperial rangers there. Her Majesty authorized your entry, so just speak with them. And I really haven't done much...
strings.그러면 저는 모험가님 가신 다음에 프레이오스의 마법사들과 함께 도울 일을: Then after you leave, I'll work with the mages of Freios to find ways to help.
strings.(크노소스에 가자…. 분명 그곳에 답이 있을 거야.): (Let's go to Knossos... The answer must be there.)
strings.(엘 아노르 평원 서부의 오래된 나무들을 지나쳐 도착한 길 사이로 스산한: (Beyond the old trees of the western El Anoir Plains, an eerie wind blows along the path.)
I only went a little deeper beyond the El Anoir Plains, but the atmosphere is completely different.
I have a bad feeling. That is...
strings.(관리가 되지 않는 것 같은 길 끝에 실바리아 제국의 것으로 보이는 초소: (At the end of a neglected path stand a guard post and barricade bearing the markings of the Silvaria Empire.)
strings.(유격병 복장의 사람이 이곳으로 오는 %s의 모습을 멀리서 확인하고 경계: (A figure in ranger's clothing spots %s approaching from afar and takes a defensive stance.)
strings.멈춰라! 움직이면 제국법에 의해 공격하겠다. 신분을 확인할 수 있는 물건: Halt! Move, and I will attack under imperial law. Show something proving your identity.
strings.(유격병이 여전히 경계한 채로 다가와 %s의 손에 있던 종이봉투를 낚아챈: (Still wary, the ranger approaches and snatches the paper envelope from %s's hand.)
strings.잠깐 확인하겠다. 분명 이건 황가에서 서신을 전할 때 쓰는…. 황가의 문: Let me check. This is what the imperial family uses for correspondence... The imperial crest... Even Her Majesty's name matches. Then you are...
strings.안녕하십니까? 저는 실바리아 제국 유격 부대 소속 상병 하바티입니다. 평: Greetings. I am Corporal Havarti of the Silvaria Empire's ranger corps. I've heard of your accomplishments, but never imagined I'd meet you in person.
strings.겸손하시기까지…. 정말 모두에게 귀감이 되실만한 분이십니다. 이런 말씀: And humble too... You truly are an example to everyone. Forgive me for saying this, but I'm a fan!
I'm a little nervous... Ahaha, I've heard so much about yooou...
strings.크노소스에 무슨 일이십니까? 귀하신 분께서 오실 정도의 일이라면 분명 큰: What brings you to Knossos? If someone as important as you has come, it must be a serious matter...
strings.안 그래도 파견시 주의사항에 %s 님이 오시면 크노소스에 들어갈 수 있도: Actually, my assignment instructions included a clause to help %s enter Knossos if you arrived.
Yes. I will help with all my heart. But...
strings.제가 파견 나온 이후 몇 개월이 지났지만, 크노소스엔 별일은 일어나지 않: It's been several months since I was stationed here, and nothing unusual has happened in Knossos.
strings.동물과 수인들이 돌아다니고, 평소엔 볼 수 없는 요정들이 가끔 보이는 정: Animals and beastmen wander around, and occasionally you see fairies that aren't found elsewhere.
strings.굳이 있다면 제가 오기 전에 계셨던 초소장께서 탈로스에게 뭔가 물어보러: If anything, the previous post commander went to ask Talos something before I arrived and disappeared.
Yes. Though Talos said he never saw the commander.
strings.네, 크노소스의 유일한 관리자입니다. 수인들의 관리 방식이 어떤지는 잘: The sole caretaker of Knossos. I don't know how the beastmen manage it, but apparently his family has tended the place for generations.
strings.…한 번 만나보고 싶은데, 그 사람은 어디 있나요?: ...I'd like to meet him. Where is he?
If you go deeper into Knossos, you'll find him strolling around at his leisure.
strings.그나마 다행인 건 다른 수인에 비해 제국 사람들이나 외지인에게 우호적입니: Fortunately, he's friendlier toward imperial citizens and outsiders than most beastmen.
strings.혹시 탈로스에게 가는 길에 제가 도울 일이 없을까요?: Is there anything I could help with on the way to Talos?
strings.아니, 이렇게 깊은 배려심까지…. 흠, 그러면 뭘 부탁드리면 좋을지. 아: Such thoughtfulness too... Hmm, what could I ask? Aha!
strings.기분 좋게 가셨으면 좋겠습니다! 저는 그것만으로 만족합니다. 사랑합니다,: Please have a pleasant visit! That alone will satisfy me. I love you, Adventurer!
strings.(맨 정신으로 듣기엔 힘든 그런 멘트 같은데….): (That's a bit much to hear with a straight face...)
I'd like to guide you myself, but I'm on duty. I'm sorry.
Ahaha... Then I'll have a pleasant visit. See you later, Havarti.
strings.(그런데 여기…. 내가 들어가려고 하니까 분위기가 바뀌었네. 요동치고 있: (But this place... The atmosphere changed as I was about to enter. It's stirring.)
strings.(알 수 없는 조형물과 폭포, 그리고 숲이 뒤엉켜 묘한 분위기를 자아낸다: (Strange structures, waterfalls, and forest intertwine in an uncanny landscape. An untended path stretches endlessly between them.)
That stirring feeling seems to have faded. Was it my imagination? Hmm...
strings.(어느 정도 걸어가자 시야에 누군가 서 있는 모습이 들어온다.): (After walking some distance, the adventurer sees someone standing ahead.)
strings.유격병 하바티가 말했던 그 사람인가?: Is that the person Ranger Havarti mentioned?
strings.(눈보다 하얗고 긴 머리카락을 가지고 있는 남자가 이쪽을 바라본다. 침착: (A man with long hair whiter than snow looks this way. Despite his calm expression, his ears are tense and alert.)
strings.(잘은 모르겠지만, 먹이를 노리는 맹수 느낌이 나…. 동물 귀는 있지만,: (I'm not sure, but he feels like a predator watching its prey... Animal ears, but no tail. He doesn't seem to be a beastman... And he feels different from the Kali people...)
I'm Talos, caretaker of Knossos. Good to meet you.
strings.(탈로스라고 자신을 소개한 남자가 손을 내밀어 악수를 청한다.): (The man who introduced himself as Talos extends a hand.)
strings.(생각보다 큰 손이네.): (His hand is bigger than I expected.)
What are you doing? You're leaving my hand embarrassed.
strings.%s…? 이름 좋군. 어디서 들었지 흔한 이름이 아니라 그런가? %s,: %s...? Nice name. Where have I heard it? Maybe because it isn't common? %s, %s... Just call me by my name. We're not in the same organization anyway...
All right, Talos. There's something I'd like to ask...
%s? %s! I'd like to return your interest in a little while.
For now, help me clean things up.
strings.내게 원하는 게 있어서 여기 온 거 아냐? 그러면 지금 내가 필요로 하는: You came here because you want something from me, right? Then focus on what I need right now.
Just do what you always do. There, that way.
strings.(탈로스가 말을 끝내자마자 자신이 가리킨 곳으로 달려간다.): (Talos immediately runs toward the place he indicated.)
strings.(이 사람 대체 뭐야? 항상 하던 대로 하자니….): (What is with this person? Do what I always do...?)
Knossos isn't normally like this. It's as calm as still water.
strings.남아있는 수인들도 별로 없고, 정령이나 요정 같은 존재들도 조용히 다니고: Not many beastmen remain, and spirits and fairies usually move about quietly...
strings.그런데 다들 공격적으로 나오는 거죠?: But now they're all acting aggressively?
strings.날 놀라게 하려고 그러는 걸까? 내가 뭘 잘못했나?: Are they trying to surprise me? Did I do something wrong?
strings.(탈로스가 턱을 매만지며 심각한 표정을 짓는다.): (Talos strokes his chin with a serious expression.)
They're sensitive to outside power... Ah, I think I understand.
Some power you possess, or some power directed at you, is stirring this place.
strings.아무리 뛰어난 마법사와 전사가 왔어도 이곳은 아무렇지도 않았는데…. 너는: Even the finest mages and warriors never disturbed it... How deeply are you involved with these things called gods?
Wait. That's a strange way to put it...
A god precious to one person may be meaningless to another.
For me and most of the lives in Knossos, it's the latter. Gods whose existence makes no difference.
strings.정작 간절할 때, 신이란 존재가 나타나지 않을 때도 있잖아. 안 그래도: When you need them most, gods sometimes fail to appear. And the ancient gods have a history of fleeing, too.
strings.나에겐 적어도 그렇단 이야기지. 어차피 볼 수도 만날 수도 없는 신이니까: That's how it is for me, at least. If I can't see or meet them anyway, surely I can resent them a little. Right?
strings.이러고 있을 틈이 없어. 녀석들이 몰려왔잖아. 크노소스의 주민들은 손님받: No time for this. Here they come. Knossos's residents don't like guests, so let's drive them off.
If you have questions, ask afterward.
strings.어느 정도 쫓아냈으니까 잠깐은 조용해지겠지. 하지만, 계속해서 민감하게: We've driven off enough that it should be quiet for a while. But they'll keep reacting to you.
strings.자, 시간은 많으니까 그럼 본론으로 들어가 볼까?: Now, we've got plenty of time. Shall we get to the point?
All right. Ask or request whatever you want. I'll hear it and decide.
strings.인간 제국 사람들에게는 신경 쓸 필요없는 그런 곳이지. 크리드의 기억이: A place people of the human empire needn't concern themselves with. Where Creed's memories sleep, you might say.
strings.오래전, 이곳에서 전쟁이 일어났어. 실바리아 제국이 대륙의 패권을 잡아가: Long ago, there was a war here. As the Silvaria Empire gained control of the continent, the beastmen apparently became an inconvenience.
strings.자국을 보호하기 위한다는 말로, 이곳을 침범했어. 그때 수인 제국 크리드: They invaded, claiming to protect their own country. People said the Beastman Empire of Creed would fall, but...
strings.제네시스인가? 제네리스? 그런 이름의 마법사 때문에 도와줘서 살았다고 한: Genesis? Generis? A mage with a name like that helped, and they survived.
strings.이런 건 제국 사람들이 모르지. 역사는 언제나 승리자의 것이고, 사라진: Imperial citizens don't know these things. History always belongs to the victors, and forgotten stories aren't interesting.
strings.신들이 도망가던 그때도, 실바리아 제국에게도 짓밟히던 그때의 기억을 고스: Knossos remembers everything: when the gods fled, and when the Silvaria Empire trampled it. Perhaps that's why...
strings.원하지 않는 힘이 있다면 자연스레 거부해. 신기하게도 말이다. 네가 몰고: It naturally rejects power it doesn't want. Strange, isn't it? The power you brought is what has made the place like this.
strings.크노소스에서 원하는 게 뭐야?: What do you want from Knossos?
strings.(나를 제국 사람으로 알고 있네. 전부 다 말할 필요는 없겠지만….): (He thinks I'm from the empire. I don't need to tell him everything...)
strings.뭔가 고민하는 표정이군. 방금 전까지는 뭔가 잔뜩 알아내려고 하는 것 같: You look troubled. A moment ago, you seemed eager to learn everything.
I need an object that's here.
strings.굴러다니는 유물 같은 게 필요한 건가? 많아서 하나쯤 가져가도 상관없긴: Some relic lying around? There are plenty, so I wouldn't mind you taking one...
strings.너 혹시 초인 같은 거냐?: Are you something like a Champion?
strings.크노소스가 동요할 정도의 힘이라면 다른 대륙에 있는 초인 정도의 사람일: Enough power to disturb Knossos... You must be on the level of the Champions on that other continent. Or one of the church's Demigods...
strings.너는 딱 보니 신성한 데미갓과는 멀어 보이는 불경한 사람같아. 역시 냄새: You look far too irreverent to be a sacred Demigod. Yes, there's a smell about you. Haha.
I really do have a good eye for people. Hehe.
strings.(…그냥 저렇게 생각하게 둬야겠다. 그런데 냄새?): (...I'll let him think that. But a smell?)
strings.…필요한 게 있으면 저쪽으로 가봐. 찾는 게 뭔지는 모르지만, [ 심장의: ...If you need something, go that way. I don't know what you're looking for, but try the Memory of the Heart.
strings.나는 실바리아 제국하고 엮이고 싶지 않으니까 빨리 볼일 보고 돌아가. 찾: I don't want to get involved with the Silvaria Empire, so finish your business and go. I hope you find what you want quickly. Come back if you have questions.
strings.난 이 근처에 있을 거야. 안그래도 풀을 뽑을 때가 됐다. 아, 심장의: I'll be nearby. It's time to pull the weeds anyway. Oh, the Memory of the Heart is farther inside.
Thank you, Talos. I'll go there.
strings.그런 걸 가지고 뭘. 크노소스의 관리자로서 알려준 것뿐이다. 지금은 유일: Nothing to thank me for. I'm only doing my job as Knossos's caretaker. Its only one now...
strings.거짓말이 서투르네, 여신의 모험가께선…. 과연 네가 가서 살아남을 수 있: You're a poor liar, adventurer of the goddess... I wonder whether you'll survive in there.
That so-called grand duke personally woke the two who were sleeping...
strings.아, 정말 귀찮네. 짤랑거리는 소리가 들리는 걸 보니 대공께서 이곳으로: Ah, what a nuisance. That jingling sound... Has His Grace come for an outing?
strings.제국 기사 놈도 왔다 가고, 사투리 쓰는 정령도 왔다 가고, 용병단 꼬맹: An imperial knight comes and goes, a spirit with an accent comes and goes, a little mercenary comes and goes. Like a stage set up exactly as the grand duke wishes.
strings.(탈로스의 빈정거림과 함께 어디선가 날아온 검은 나비가 사람의 형상을 만: (At Talos's sarcastic words, black butterflies fly in and form a human shape.)
It has been a while, Talos. Or rather...
Don't use that name. And don't bother with your irritating formalities.
Courtesy is natural for a being with intellect and thought.
Hahahahaha! Amusing. Me? Someone asked a favor.
strings.알고도 장난에 놀아날 셈입니까?: You intend to play along with the joke even knowing that?
Then answer me, Your Grace. Why have you come out again?
strings.먼저 다가올 밤이 어떻게 될지는 모르겠지만, 저 나름대로 준비하고 있는: I do not know what will become of the first approaching night, but I have preparations of my own.
strings.(탈로스가 인상을 쓰며 바르바토스의 멱살을 잡는다.): (Talos scowls and grabs Barbatos by the collar.)
strings.어차피 당신과 나는 갈 길이 다릅니다. 당신이 신을 위한 자를 죽인 것과: Our paths are different, after all. Mine differs from yours, who killed one who served a god...
strings.(바르바토스가 씨익 웃자 그를 맴돌던 검은 나비가 갑자기 증식한다. 깜짝: (Barbatos grins, and the black butterflies around him suddenly multiply. Startled, Talos steps back.)
strings.빌어먹을 나비…. 어떤 여신의 것이 떠올라. 저게 더 기분 나쁘긴 하지만: Damned butterflies... They remind me of a certain goddess's. Though those are even more unpleasant...
strings.(검은 나비가 끌고 온 검은 빛이 어느새 바르바토스를 감싸더니 이내 사라: (The darkness carried by the butterflies envelops Barbatos, then disappears.)
Fine, Grand Duke... Let's see who gets to laugh first.
strings.(습한 냄새가 가득한 숲속, 멀리 기계와 전선으로 이어진 큰 구조물이 보: (Deep in the damp-smelling forest, a large structure connected to machinery and cables stands in the distance.)
strings.(게다가 어디선가 정체를 알 수 없는 소리가 흘러나와 귀를 괴롭힌다.): (An unidentified sound drifts from somewhere, grating on the ears.)
(It's familiar... I know it. The sound of machinery coming from somewhere...)
Is that a bell? As though it's attached to something...
strings.(방울 소리가 점점 가까워지는 것 같더니 갑자기 들려오지 않는다.): (The bell seems to draw closer, then suddenly falls silent.)
What do you mean, sweetie? It's me. Pasiphae.
strings.(자신을 파시파에라고 칭하는 소녀가 팔을 벌려 안으려고 한다. 하지만,: (The girl calling herself Pasiphae opens her arms for an embrace, then realizes something and steps back.)
Aww, you're not my sweetie. Some little octopus turned up instead.
Excuse me. I'm not an octopus...
strings.(고양이 귀? 그러면 수인은 아닌 것 같은데…. 칼리 족? 아냐. 뭔가: (Cat ears? Then she doesn't seem to be a beastman... One of the Kali people? No, something's different... She has a tail.)
strings.(파시파에의 움직임에 따라 그녀의 목에 있는 방울 소리가 들려온다.): (The bell around Pasiphae's neck jingles as she moves.)
strings.(아, 이 방울은 저 사람의 것인가? 그런데 저 소녀, 인기척도 못 느낄: (Oh, the bell was hers? But she appeared behind me without my sensing her at all. What...?)
I'm Pasiphae. One of Knossos's great caretakers.
strings.(분명 크노소스의 관리자는 한 명이라고 했는데….): (I was told there was only one caretaker...)
strings.그런데 인간, 너는 누구양? 제레니스가 보낸 사람이양?: But who are you, human? Did Xerenis send you?
strings.그래, 제레니스. 난 또 우리 자기가 날 찾으러 온 줄 알았지. 나중에: Yes, Xerenis. I thought my sweetie had come looking for me. Go see him later.
strings.그런데 여기서 어떻게 나가지? 매일 들어오는 곳을 빠져나갈 수 없다니 이: But how do I get out of here? Strange, isn't it? I can't leave a place I enter every day.
I think it's been like this since my sweetie gave me that...
How did you get in here? You'd need a caretaker's permission...
strings.(순간 손을 핥고 있던 파시파에의 눈빛이 달라진다. 그리고 빠른 속도로: (Pasiphae's eyes change as she licks her hand. A dagger appears at her fingertips and flashes toward %s's throat.)
That wasn't the end of it... Huh? What's this? Black butterflies...
strings.(갑자기 어디선가 날아온 검은 나비들이 파시파에의 주위를 감싸기 시작한다: (Black butterflies suddenly fly in and surround Pasiphae.)
strings.(깊은 어둠으로 변한 나비는 그대로 파시파에를 삼킨 채 그대로 흩어져 버: (The butterflies turn into deep darkness, swallow Pasiphae, and scatter.)
(Pasiphae's bell rings frantically, then grows quieter.)
strings.(심장의 기억을 한참 맴돌던 중, 한쪽에서 파시파에의 방울 소리가 희미하: (After wandering through the Memory of the Heart, the adventurer faintly hears Pasiphae's bell from one side.)
strings.(조금 더 걸어가자 어둠을 흩뿌리는 검은 나비들의 잔상이 보인다. 이어: (A little farther on, traces of black butterflies shedding darkness appear. Barbatos and Pasiphae slowly come into view.)
strings.(이야기 중인 것 같은데, 잠깐 지켜보자.): (They seem to be talking. I'll watch for a moment.)
Barbatos, was it? What a difficult name.
strings.그러니까 대공, 당신 말대로라면 우리 자기가 보낸 부하들이 우리를 배신했: So, Grand Duke, you're saying the subordinates my sweetie sent betrayed us?
And handed our empire over to Silvaria...
strings.제레니스는 우리와 함께 프레이오스의 미래를 약속했어. 수인과 인간이 함께: Xerenis promised us a future for Freios together. A continent where beastmen and humans would live as one...
strings.위대한 마법사 제레니스께서는 살해당했으니 함께 할 수 없었습니다. 그리고: The great mage Xerenis was murdered and could not join you. And you, a great warrior, and the beastmen's great king were put to sleep by a subordinate.
strings.신을 믿지 않는 자가 신의 힘을 가져와 크노소스의 시간을 멈추다니, 참: Someone who does not believe in gods used divine power to stop time in Knossos. How interesting.
strings.그것도 몇백 년이나…. 다른 대륙에서도 있었던 일이군요. 시기도 비슷하고: For several hundred years, too... Something similar happened on another continent, around the same time...
strings.(잠깐, 이거 어디선가 들었던….): (Wait, I've heard something like this before...)
strings.그래도 신이 될 제가 특별히 당신들을 깨웠습니다. 하지만, 당신들을 각: Still, I, who will become a god, took the trouble to wake you. Though I could not free you from your respective areas.
strings.당신들의 부하는 꽤 치밀했습니다. 제가 예전에 한 번 당신들을 깨우려 했: Your subordinate was quite thorough. I tried waking you once before, but you were too deeply asleep.
strings.장난을 쳐도 정말 지독하지 않습니까?: Even as a prank, isn't it terribly cruel?
strings.당신의 머리에 있는 그 나비 머리 장식. 오래전, 수인왕께 우정의 증표로: The butterfly ornament in your hair. Long ago, I gave it to the beastman king as a token of friendship.
He said there was a woman he cherished.
strings.어머, 우리 자기가? 그러면 믿어볼까? 대공, 그러면 나는 뭘 하면 돼?: Oh, my sweetie did? Then maybe I can trust you. Grand Duke, what should I do?
strings.저쪽에서 우리 이야기를 엿듣고 있는 여신의 모험가와 이야기 하는 건 어떻: Why not speak with the goddess's adventurer, who is eavesdropping over there?
As I told you before, %s, you have no choice.
strings.(파시파에가 씨익 웃더니 두 자루의 단검을 손에 쥔다. 그리고 빠른 속도: (Pasiphae grins and draws two daggers. Moving at incredible speed, she appears behind Barbatos.)
strings.감히 마족 따위가 수인 최고 전사에게 이래라 저래라 하네? 이렇게 쉽게: A mere fiend dares order the beastmen's greatest warrior around? When you give up your throat so easily...
strings.(바르바토스가 목에 다가온 단검을 손가락 끝으로 살며시 밀어낸다.): (Barbatos gently pushes the dagger away from his throat with a fingertip.)
strings.참으로 유감입니다. 제 입에서 유감을 다시 말하게 만들다니…. 파시파에: How regrettable. To make me say it again... Miss Pasiphae, you truly are foolish. I came to help...
strings.어리석은 신을 믿고 인간과 하나가 될 수 있다고 믿었던 수인이니까 이런: A beastman who trusted foolish gods and believed humans and beastmen could unite... Of course you would make such a choice.
U-ugh... My arms are m-moving on their own...
strings.여기서 제가 당신을 벨 수도 있지만, 당신은 제게 어울리지 않는 상대입니: I could cut you down here, but you are no fitting opponent for me. That must be why you stand beside that foolish beastman king.
I'll kill you. But my body is moving on its own...
strings.당신은 당신과 어울리는 상대와 겨루시기 바랍니다. 저기 보이는 여신의 모: Please fight someone suited to you. That adventurer of the goddess will do nicely.
strings.(바르바토스의 말과 함께 파시파에가 천천히 %s의 앞으로 걸어간다.): (At Barbatos's words, Pasiphae slowly walks toward %s.)
Barbatos. After what you did to Lady Michaela...
strings.미카? 옛날에 신들과 함께 싸우던?: Mika? The one who fought alongside the gods long ago?
strings.여신의 모험가께선 저에게서 전투 천사도 구원해주셨으니, 수인족의 고대 전: You saved even a battle angel from me, adventurer of the goddess. I hope you will save this ancient beastman warrior too.
strings.새로운 밤을 준비하는 마녀, 멍청한 마계 군주 럭스, 죄인이 불러온 공포: A witch preparing a new night, that foolish ruler of the Demon Realm, Lux, and the god of terror summoned by a sinner...
strings.노인께선 정말 징그럽게 많은 것을 준비하셨군요. 이 세계를 파멸시키기 위: The old man has prepared a revolting number of things to destroy this world...
strings.(안경을 고쳐쓰던 바르바토스의 표정이 일그러진다. 하지만, 이내 침착한: (Barbatos's face twists as he adjusts his glasses, but he soon regains his composure.)
strings.후우, 결례를 범했군요. 할 일이 많아서 이만 물러나겠습니다. 제가 별: Whew. How rude of me. I have much to do, so I shall leave. I've said far too much.
strings.그리고 파시파에 양, 제가 했던 말 중에선 거짓이 없습니다. 제 말의 진: And Miss Pasiphae, nothing I told you was a lie. That adventurer will prove my words, so fight to the death.
strings.깨어난 수인왕께선 지금 어떤 모습이실지 기대됩니다. 그가 분노한다면 프레: I look forward to seeing the awakened beastman king. If he gives in to anger, Freios will surely...
strings.자, 파시파에 양. 당신들이 아끼는 신, 그리고 그 신이 선택한 모험가를: Now, Miss Pasiphae. Cut down the god you cherish, and the adventurer that god chose.
A life as a godslayer, a Deicide, would not be so bad...
strings.미카엘라 님때와 비슷한 상황이야…. 가능할지 모르겠지만 내 힘으로 해봐야: It's like what happened to Lady Michaela... I don't know if it'll work, but I have to try with my power.
strings.(힘겨운 전투 끝에 혼신의 힘을 다한 %s의 마지막 일격이 파시파에를 스: (After a difficult battle, %s puts every last ounce of strength into a final strike that grazes Pasiphae.)
strings.(까다로운 상대였어. 그러니까 부디 이 공격이 마지막이어야 해. 버티기: (She was a difficult opponent. Please let that be the last attack. I can barely hold on...)
strings.(파시파에의 다리에 힘이 풀렸는지, 파시파에가 그대로 주저앉는다.): (Pasiphae's legs give way, and she sinks to the ground.)
strings.난 괜찮앙. 덕분에 원래대로 돌아왔으니까…. 대공이란 마족 때문에 힘을: I'm fine. You brought me back to normal... That fiend calling himself a grand duke made me use so much strength.
strings.(파시파에가 무기를 거두고, %s의 얼굴을 빤히 바라본다.): (Pasiphae puts away her weapons and stares at %s's face.)
Nothing. I feel like I've seen you before... Oh, that's not it.
strings.이 리본, 우리 자기가 준 거라 그냥 한 건데, 저 대공이란 마족의 힘이: This ribbon... I only wore it because my sweetie gave it to me. But it carried that grand duke's power. It's gone now...
strings.그런데 이상해. 내가 마족의 힘에 지배될 이유는 없는데…. 저 대공은 뭐: But it's strange. A fiend's power shouldn't be able to control me... What is that grand duke?
Then tell me the short version.
strings.나를 못 믿는구낭. 이야기해주면 내가 최대한 협조할게. 여신의 모험가라고: You don't trust me, huh? Tell me, and I'll help as much as I can. You're the goddess's adventurer, right? You didn't come here for nothing.
strings.(파시파에에게 새로운 여신 이리스와 바르바토스의 정체, 그리고 크노소스에: (The adventurer briefly tells Pasiphae about the new goddess Iris, Barbatos's identity, and the reason for coming to Knossos.)
strings.세레스 여신님의 후계자가 있었구낭. 남아있는 신들이 얼마나 있는지도 몰랐: So Goddess Seres has a successor. I didn't even know how many gods remained... And that grand duke wants to become this world's god himself...
strings.뒤틀린 자 '데이모스'를 본 적은 없지만, 그게 나타나면 얼마나 위험한지: I've never seen the Twisted One Deimos, but I know how dangerous his arrival would be. Maybe not as dangerous as the Demon King, the Beast...
I once felt that terror approaching Freios.
That's why I'm looking for a way to stop Deimos here.
strings.여기? 여기는 그럴만한 게 없는데…. 아, 이건강?: Here? There's nothing like that here... Oh, could it be this?
strings.(파시파에가 품 안에서 뭔가 꺼내 %s에게 보여준다.): (Pasiphae takes something out and shows it to %s.)
strings.우리 자기와의 사랑의 징표라 할 수 있는 분노의 심장이야. 나머지 반은: The Heart of Rage. You could call it a token of our love. My sweetie has the other half.
strings.까, 깜짝이야. 이거 뭐에요? 진짜 심장처럼 뛰고 있잖아요!: Th-that startled me! What is this? It's beating like a real heart!
That's right. A heart. It's also the heart of the golems we treasure.
strings.황혼 시절, 신들을 위해 우리가 만들었던 골렘이 여기 잔뜩 있잖아. 심장: We made so many golems for the gods during the twilight. They should be here, charging from the heart... Huh?
Gone...? They're all gone! Our golems, sleeping in the Heart of Knossos... Gone!
strings.그래. 골렘. 골렘이 없는 걸 보니 크리드는 완전히 배신당했나 봐…. 안: Yes, golems. If they're gone, Creed must have been completely betrayed... This won't do. I have to tell my sweetie quickly. Come with me. I'll help.
strings.나 여기서 나갈 수 없어…. 이곳에 펼쳐진 어떤 힘이 날 막고 있어. 이: I can't leave... Some power spread through this place is stopping me. Is this that grand duke's doing too?
strings.어쩔 수 없징. 네가 나 대신 우리 자기를 만나러 가. 내가 이렇다는 건: Nothing for it. Go see my sweetie for me. If I'm stuck here, he must be unable to leave his place too.
I wonder what he's doing now...
Don't worry too much. I'll go and meet him.
Then I'll entrust the Heart of Rage to you.
strings.(파시파에가 품에서 심장 모양의 돌을 꺼내 %s의 손에 쥐어준다.): (Pasiphae takes the heart-shaped stone from her clothes and places it in %s's hand.)
strings.(이게 바로 분노의 심장…. 강한 진동이 느껴져. 마치 화를 내고 있는: (So this is the Heart of Rage... It vibrates powerfully. As though it's angry.)
strings.분노의 심장은 신께서 맡긴 이 세계의 일부야. 황혼 시대의 물건…. 일: The Heart of Rage is a part of this world entrusted to us by a god. An object from the twilight... My sweetie has the other half. Put them together, and it should help stop the Twisted One.
strings.고마워요, 파시파에. 그러면 그분을 만나러 어디로 가야 하죠?: Thank you, Pasiphae. Where should I go to meet him?
strings.[아크로의 관]…. 금방 찾을 수 있을 거야. 나중에 나도 나올 수 있도: Acro's Coffin... You'll find it easily. You have to help me get out later too, all right?
strings.나는 걱정하지 마. 여기는 내 땅이라 괜찮을 거얌. 마침 네 여신, 새로: Don't worry about me. This is my land, so I'll be fine. Your goddess, the new goddess, says it'll be all right too.
I will... I'm sorry. I'll find a way and come back.
Such a tender-hearted child, just like Xerenis. Next time, I'll ask if we can be friends.
strings.그런데, 대공이 분명 신을 믿지 않는 자가 신의 힘을 가져와 크노소스의: But the grand duke clearly said someone who didn't believe in gods used divine power to stop time in Knossos.
strings.(…탈로스, 다이달로스. 둘 중 누구야? 이런 일을 벌인 게….): (...Talos. Daedalus. Which one of you did this?)
No. I haven't found what I need yet. But Talos...
strings.저 안에서 마족이 나타났어요. 뭐 아는 거 없어요?: A fiend appeared in there. Do you know anything about it?
A fiend? Why would one be in Knossos...? I know nothing...
strings.(정말 모르는 건가? 모르는 척하는 건가? 그래도 일을 방해하는 게 아니: (Does he really not know, or is he pretending? Still, he isn't getting in my way, so I won't dwell on it.)
Really? Hmm. Then I'll have to go to Acro's Coffin.
strings.그런데, 마족이 뭐라고 했어?: But what did the fiend say?
He wondered what the king would be like if he became angry...
strings.분노하는 사람이 누군지는 모르겠지만, 이런 잊힌 땅에서 그런 사람은 없어: I don't know who this angry person is, but there's no one like that in this forgotten land. A mere caretaker like me has nothing to be angry about. But a fiend...
Anyway, I'll go to Acro's Coffin, as discussed.
I'll be wandering around, so find me if anything happens.
Oh, Acro's Coffin will be a little more complicated than the Memory of the Heart.
I'm sure it'll be fine. I'll be going.
strings.(무슨 일이 일어날 것 같은 기분인데…. 어, 이리스?): (I feel like something's about to happen... Huh, Iris?)
strings.(%s…. 크노소스의 상태가 조금 이상해요. 제가 잠시 안전한 곳으로 보: (%s... Something is strange about Knossos. I'll send you somewhere safe for a moment.)
strings.(탈로스가 멀리서 %s의 모습을 지켜보다 갑자기 그의 모습이 사라지자 가: (Watching %s from afar, Talos gives a faint laugh when the adventurer suddenly vanishes.)
It has nothing to do with me for now. Shall I just wait and see...?
You startled me, appearing so suddenly.
strings.저도 메디아 님이 눈앞에 나타나서 놀랐어요. 그나저나 다행이에요. 이번엔: I was surprised to see you in front of me too, Lady Medea. But what a relief. I didn't fall out of the sky this time!
Ah, Lady Iris must still be learning. But you've brought something. May I see it?
strings.(메디아에게 반쪽짜리 분노의 심장을 보여주면서 크노소스와 [심장의 기억]: (The adventurer shows Medea the half of the Heart of Rage and recounts what happened in Knossos and the Memory of the Heart.)
strings.프레이오스에 전쟁이 있었던 시기, 크노소스에 적이 들어오면 폭발을 일으켜: The Heart of Rage... The mysterious object said to have exploded and driven enemies from Knossos during the war in Freios...
Even as a half, I can feel something. This anger...
strings.그리고 말씀해주신 관리자 탈로스와 파시파에의 모습은 역시 예상대로 칼리: And as I expected, the caretakers Talos and Pasiphae you described differ little from the Kali people.
Moreover, receiving a message from the goddess means...
There is much to unravel, but it isn't so complicated, %s...
strings.수인왕이 나머지 반쪽을 가지고 있으시다니 하나로 만들기 위해선 제가 필요: If the beastman king holds the other half, you will need me to make them whole.
strings.(메디아가 하늘을 바라보며 이리스의 이름을 부른다. 그러자 잠시 후, %: (Medea looks up and calls Iris's name. A moment later, Iris slowly appears beside %s.)
I know it is difficult, but I would like you to send me to Knossos as well.
strings.저는 괜찮아요. 그러면 준비가 다 되신 건가요?: I'm all right. Then are you ready?
Whether to go to Knossos or to act for Eastland, I have made up my mind. I will go and find what I must do there.
Thank you, Lady Medea. Then I'll hurry. And %s...
strings.응, 이리스. 그런데 크노소스의 흐름이 이상해질 것 같다는 건 무슨 말이: Yes, Iris. But what did you mean about Knossos's energy turning strange?
strings.잘은 모르겠지만, 누군가 신의 힘이 다가오는 걸 싫어하는 것 같아요. 그: I'm not certain, but someone seems to dislike divine power drawing near. That's why I sent you here for now.
strings.지금 크노소스 쪽도 괜찮은 것 같아요. 그래서 메디아 님과 함께 다시 갈: Knossos seems all right again. I'll let you return with Lady Medea.
I'll make sure you land well this time. Don't worry.
strings.(이리스가 미안한 표정을 짓는다는 걸 깨달았을 때는 이미 한참 늦은 뒤였: (By the time the adventurer notices Iris's apologetic expression, it is already far too late.)
I heard something land with a thud. So it was you.
strings.그런데 거기, 당신…. 이 녀석이랑 일행인 것 같은데, 신의 사람인가?: And you there... You seem to be with this one. Are you a servant of a god?
Heh. You really are different from that person. Those clothes, that staff...
Please refrain from comparing me to someone you know.
strings.살아있는 존재기에 자신이 알고 있는 다른 존재와 비교를 하는 건 어쩔 수: Living beings can't help comparing others with what they know. Anyway, is this your first visit to Knossos?
My first, but I do not wish to stay long.
strings.하아…. 당신이 신을 좋아하지 않는 건 알겠습니다. 그러니 그분과 관련됐: Sigh... I understand you dislike gods. That must be why you are involved with that person.
Our aims simply align. Nothing more.
strings.그분이 어떤 일을 행할 때도 그런 말을 하셨죠. 하지만, 그 결과가 어떤: You said the same when that person acted before. But you know very well what came of it.
Enough. Finish your business and leave. Otherwise...
Thank you. I will exchange no further words with you after this.
strings.(메디아가 아직도 정신을 차리지 못하는 %s의 어깨에 지팡이를 댄다.): (Medea rests her staff against %s's shoulder while the adventurer is still dazed.)
strings.아직 여신께서 먼 거리는 제어가 힘드신 것 같군요. 괜찮으신가요?: It seems the goddess still struggles to control long-distance travel. Are you all right?
strings.네, 덕분에 좋아졌어요.. 그런데, 탈로스와 이야기를 하셨던 것 같은데…: Yes. I feel better, thanks to you... But you seemed to be speaking with Talos...
I will explain after we meet the beastman king. Come.
Oh, never mind. Let's go first.
strings.(탈로스가 [아크로의 관]으로 향하는 메디아와 %s의 뒷모습을 빤히 바라: (Talos stares after Medea and %s as they head toward Acro's Coffin.)
strings.역시 그 여자가 비빌 구석이라고 말할만 하네. 하지만, 다른 길을 가겠지: No wonder that woman called her someone she could rely on. But she'll take a different path. Now that I've confirmed it, shall I play a little prank of my own...?
strings.(탈로스가 지팡이를 들어 하늘에 떠있는 태양을 가리킨다.): (Talos raises his staff and points at the sun.)
The beastman king is rather pitiful. Waking after such a long sleep...
strings.(지팡이 끝이 땅을 두드리자 알 수 없는 기운이 흘러나온다. 그리고 크노: (As the tip of the staff taps the ground, a strange energy flows out, drawing forth a resonance never before felt in Knossos.)
strings.하늘이 울고, 땅이 분노하고 있구나…. 아, %s, 가는 길을 조심해야: The sky weeps, and the earth rages... Ah, %s, watch your step.
The ground shaking so suddenly startled me.
Someone unhappy about our arrival probably caused it.
strings.네, 우리…. 무슨 문제라도 있나요?: Yes. Our. Is there a problem?
strings.사소한 건 신경 쓰시지 말고, 아크로의 관에서 수인왕을 만나는 것에 집중: Pay no mind to such small things. Focus on meeting the beastman king in Acro's Coffin.
Still, this place seems to have more buried beneath it than I expected...
strings.거짓말쟁이가 뭘 숨기고 있는지 알아야겠지만, 쉽게 알려주지는 않을 테죠…: We must learn what the liar is hiding, though he will not tell us easily...
strings.안 돼…. 안 돼!! 이럴 리 없어!! 크아아아악!!: No... No! This cannot be! Aaaaaagh!
Grrrr... Why has this land that I, Minos, protected become like this...?
(A voice cries out in rage, and the ground that had stilled begins shaking again.)
That seems to be the beastman king's voice. Minos must be his name.
strings.어쨌든 수인왕께서 뭔가 깨닫고 분노를 참지 못하시는군요…. 땅이 품고 있: Whatever the case, he has realized something and cannot contain his anger... The energy within the land seems to be feeding it...
strings.그를 힘들게 만든 원인이 뭔지는 우리가 알 수 없지만, 이 만남이 절대: We do not know what has caused his suffering, but this meeting will certainly be difficult.
But you needn't worry too much.
strings.%s, 심장의 기억을 헤매셨다고 하셨죠?: %s, you said you wandered through the Memory of the Heart, correct?
This place seems much the same. Some mechanisms have been put in place... I'll undo what I can...
strings.%s, 당신은 앞으로 먼저 가세요. 그러면 적어도 오랫동안 길을 헤매진: %s, go ahead first. Then at least you won't spend too long lost.
Meet the beastman king and keep him talking for as long as you can. I'll follow soon.
strings.빨리 그를 막아야 할 것 같습니다…. 그의 힘이 분노의 심장을 이용한다면: We must stop him quickly... If his power uses the Heart of Rage, the consequences will not end with Knossos...
strings.(%s가 먼저 떠나고 뒤이어 또다시 수인왕의 분노가 이어진다.): (%s departs, and the beastman king's rage soon rings out again.)
Aaaaaagh! Now that you have entered this place, you will never leave alive...
strings.(수인왕의 분노와 절규가 크노소스를 가득 채우고 있다.): (The beastman king's furious cries fill Knossos.)
I can feel pain... This is...
I'll keep your anger from growing. Please hold on a little longer...
strings.(아크로의 관 중심부로 향하는 동안, 방해되는 존재들이 쓰러지거나 모두: (As the adventurer heads toward the center of Acro's Coffin, the beings in the way fall or retreat.)
strings.후우, 겨우 여기까지 왔네…. 다행이야, 많이 헤매지 않았어. 이게 다: Whew, I finally made it this far... Good thing I didn't get too lost. Is it all thanks to Lady Medea?
Now I only need to get over this hill...
strings.(조금 전까지 크노소스를 뒤엎던 미노스의 절규가 더는 들려오지 않는다.): (Minos's cries, which shook all of Knossos moments ago, can no longer be heard.)
strings.뭔가 이상한데…. 왜 갑자기 멈춘 거지?: Something's wrong... Why did it stop so suddenly?
strings.네가 왜 심장의 조각을 가지고 있지?: Why do you have a fragment of the heart?
strings.(크노소스를 가득 채웠던 목소리의 주인공이 갑자기 땅에서 솟아난 것처럼: (The owner of the voice that filled Knossos suddenly appears as though rising from the ground. Startled, the adventurer falls.)
strings.내 모습을 보고 놀라다니 심히 불쾌하군. 자비를 베푸니 이걸 잡고 일어나: To be frightened at the sight of me is most displeasing. I shall show mercy. Take this and rise.
strings.(미노스가 넘어진 %s의 앞으로 지팡이를 내민다.): (Minos extends his staff toward %s on the ground.)
strings.나는 크리드의 군주, 미노스라고 한다. 그리고 이곳은 나의 성 아크로폴리: I am Minos, sovereign of Creed. And this is my castle, Acropolis...
I will not say it again. Rise.
strings.(일단 붙잡고 일어나자….): (I'd better take it and get up...)
strings.자, 내게 고해라. 너는 누구고, 왜 파시파에가 가지고 있던 조각을 가지: Now, tell me. Who are you, and why do you have the fragment Pasiphae held?
And why have you come here...? I wish to know everything.
strings.(미노스에게 간단한 소개와 이곳에 온 이유, 그리고 파시파에가 당한 이야: (The adventurer briefly introduces themself and explains the reason for coming, along with what happened to Pasiphae.)
strings.그래서 분노의 심장이 필요하다고?: So you need the Heart of Rage?
strings.네, 그 유물이 있으면 데이모스를 불러오려고 하는 악당에게서 맞서 싸울: Yes. With that relic, we can stand against the villain trying to summon Deimos.
strings.(미노스가 조용히 품에서 분노의 심장으로 보이는 돌 조각을 꺼낸다.): (Minos quietly takes out a stone fragment that appears to be the Heart of Rage.)
You do not understand what this heart means.
strings.내가 순순히 이걸 줄 거라고 생각했나?: Did you think I would simply give it to you?
strings.(미노스가 분노의 심장 조각을 다시 품에 넣고 지팡이를 흔든다. 그러자: (Minos puts the fragment away and swings his staff. Power explodes around them, hurling the adventurer far back.)
I do not yet know whether your words are truth or lies.
strings.(신뢰…. 메디아 님과 같은 말을 하고 있어.): (Trust... He's saying the same thing as Lady Medea.)
strings.신뢰받고 싶다면 내 시험에 응하고 널 증명해라. 네가 새로운 신의 사람이: If you want my trust, face my trial and prove yourself. Prove that you serve the new god.
It will not be easy to defeat me...
strings.(미노스가 다시 한 번 지팡이를 든 채로 %s의 얼굴을 바라본다.): (Minos raises his staff again and looks at %s.)
strings.(어쩔 수 없나, 쉽지 않겠어…. 이리스, 날 지켜줘….): (No choice, then. This won't be easy... Iris, protect me...)
strings.(크노소스가 흔들릴 정도의 강한 공격이 쉬지 않고 이어진다.): (Attacks powerful enough to shake Knossos follow without pause.)
strings.(도저히 끝이 나지 않을 것 같아. 한 번에 끝내야 해.): (This will never end. I have to finish it in one blow.)
Let us stop for a moment.
strings.(미노스가 그런 %s의 표정을 읽었는지 지팡이를 안으로 거둔다. 그러다: (As though reading %s's expression, Minos lowers his staff. Then he throws something to %s.)
I will give it to you.
strings.분노의 심장…. 저를 신뢰하시는 건가요?: The Heart of Rage... Do you trust me?
strings.네 공격 속에서 믿음을 봤다. 그걸 내가 원하는 신뢰라 할 수는 없지만…: I saw faith within your attacks. I cannot call it the trust I seek... But I would like you to face me a little longer.
You are an excellent opponent for my rage. Come at me with all your strength...
strings.그러니까 더 싸우자구요? 이대로 더 싸우다간 크노소스가 위험해져요…. 미: You mean keep fighting? If we do, Knossos will be in danger... There's something dangerous about your power...
strings.(메디아가 미노스의 부름에 고개를 끄덕인다. 미노스는 미노스대로 자신의: (Medea nods at Minos's question. He watches with interest as she steps before him.)
strings.네, 그렇습니다. 당신의 분노가 멈추지 않고, 이대로 심장이 가지고 있는: Yes. You must know that your anger cannot be allowed to continue and meet the memories held within the heart...
Then you must put aside your anger.
strings.당신을 비롯해 당신이 사랑했던 크노소스가 프레이오스의 지도에서 사라지는: If you wish yourself and the Knossos you love to vanish from the map of Freios, then continue.
strings.(메디아의 말에 미노스가 어이없다는 표정을 짓는다. 그러다 미친 것처럼: (Minos looks incredulous at Medea's words, then begins laughing wildly.)
strings.수인왕이시여. 감사합니다. 반드시, 두 분께서 밖으로 나오실 수 있는 방: Beastman King, thank you. I will find a way for both of you to leave this place.
strings.(그렇다는 건…. 파시파에와 미노스 두 사람은 못 나가는 건가?): (Then... neither Pasiphae nor Minos can get out?)
Yes. I promise. If you cannot trust me, then my power...
I do not need your power. Promise me one thing instead. That human.
strings.저 인간을 수시로 내게 오게 해라. 그래야 내가 이 세계를 위하든, 너를: Have that human visit me often. Then I will do what I can, whether for this world, for you, or for a god.
Thank you, Lord Minos. And %s... Come closer.
strings.(메디아가 %s에게 두 손 안에 있는 분노의 심장 조각을 보여준다. 그러: (Medea shows %s the Heart of Rage fragments in her hands. Then she clenches her fists, shattering them.)
Lady Medea? Why would you break the Heart of Rage...? This is...
(Medea forms a sphere of power mingled with the Heart of Rage at her fingertips, then places it in %s's hand.)
strings.(%s의 손이 가슴에 닿자 구체는 그대로 안으로 스며든다.): (As %s's hand touches the adventurer's chest, the sphere sinks inside.)
What is this feeling...? At last, the power of every Champion...
strings.이렇게 이리스 님께서는 이스트랜드의 모든 걸 보실 수 있게 됐어요. 그리: Now Lady Iris will be able to see everything in Eastland. And perhaps recall some of Freios's memories as well.
strings.데이모스도 이리스 님의 영향을 받아 조금이지만 늦게 나타날 거예요. 그리: Deimos will also be affected by Lady Iris and appear a little later. Ask her about the rest.
strings.이제 크노소스의 관리자라 말하는 탈로스에게 가보세요. 저는 수인왕께 드릴: Now go to Talos, who calls himself Knossos's caretaker. I have something to discuss with the beastman king...
It will take some time. Go ahead.
All right. Then Lord Minos, I'll visit again.
strings.메디아라고 했지만, 너는 메데이아라는 이름이었다. 다프네가 선택한 아이…: You call yourself Medea, but your name was Medeia. The child Daphne chose...
strings.전 메데이아도, 그분의 아이도 아닙니다. 그저 칼리 족을 이끄는 사람일: I am neither Medeia nor that woman's child. Only the one who leads the Kali people.
So the village on the other continent is called Kali.
strings.이리스 님과 함께 언젠가 미노스 님과 파시파에 님을 이곳에서 나올 수 있: Together with Lady Iris, I will one day help you and Lady Pasiphae leave this place.
Even if you do not, someone else will come eventually. I will wait until then.
I do not know who may come, but I will do what I can.
strings.그건 그렇고 넌 신을 위한 네 선택이 너에게 독이 될 수도 있다는 걸 알: Still, you must have known that choosing to serve a god could poison you. Now that the trace of your power has gone to a god, you...
strings.(메디아는 아무렇지도 않은 듯 미소를 보인다.): (Medea smiles as though nothing is wrong.)
I am all right. I merely showed the goddess the depth of my trust.
By the look of you, you've achieved what you came to Knossos for...
She told me to come see you.
I have nothing to say. Leave. Wait, you...
The anger hanging over Knossos is gone. Tell me what happened.
strings.(탈로스에게 아크로의 관에 있었던 일을 이야기한다.): (The adventurer tells Talos what happened in Acro's Coffin.)
strings.왜 그렇게 웃어요?: Why are you laughing like that?
Nothing. This situation is just so funny...
strings.힘들게 크노소스를 잠재웠더니, 빌어먹을 대공이 찾아와 깨워버렸네?: I went to all the trouble of putting Knossos to sleep, and that damned grand duke came and woke it up.
strings.크노소스의 비밀을 캐내려는 네가 별로라 수인왕을 자극했는데, 용케 살아남: I disliked you prying into Knossos's secrets, so I provoked the beastman king. Yet you managed to survive.
strings.후우, 내가 크노소스를 제어하고 있는 이상, 별일은 없을 줄 알았는데,: Whew. I thought nothing would happen as long as I controlled Knossos, but apparently I was wrong... Ahahaha!
strings.탈로스, 당신은 미노스 님의 사람이었나요?: Talos, were you one of Lord Minos's people?
strings.나에게 관심이 많은 건 알겠지만, 오늘은 그만하면 어떨까?: I know you're interested in me, but why don't we stop for today?
strings.네 덕분에 내가 해야 할 일이 많아졌거든. 실바리아 제국과 마계에서 알아: Thanks to you, I have plenty to do. The Silvaria Empire and the Demon Realm have noticed things...
You'll find out whether you want to or not. So stay alive.
Only the dead post commander ended up unfortunate.
strings.초소장은 왜 죽은 거죠?: Why did the post commander die?
You want to learn more from me? You really are interested in me.
I'll tell you that. Commander Disel discovered a secret hidden here. He came looking for me to confirm it...
strings.그 전에 다른 누구를 만나 죽었더군…. 좋은 친구였는데. 정확히는 그 존: But before that, he met someone else and died... He was a good friend. More precisely, that being came to him...
strings.초소장은 양지바른 곳에 묻어줬다. 저쪽 어디에 무덤이 있으니까 신경 쓰지: I buried the commander in a sunny spot. His grave is over there somewhere, so don't worry. That's all I know. I don't know who the being was either. Find out for yourself...
strings.아, 뭔가 내게서 더 알아내고 싶다면 종종 찾아와. 신뢰를 쌓아야 할 거: Oh, if you want to learn more from me, visit now and then. You'll have to build trust.
strings.이곳에 말벗이 필요한 사람이 꽤 되거든. 신뢰를 어떻게 쌓을지는 네 선택: Quite a few people here need someone to talk to. How you build that trust is your choice. Hehe...
strings.(대화가 어느 정도 끝나자 탈로스가 등을 돌려 크노소스의 거리 어딘가로: (With the conversation largely finished, Talos turns away and disappears along a path in Knossos.)
What happened in this place? I achieved what I came for, but something still feels wrong...
You must have finished speaking with Talos. Then let us return to Kali.
strings.크노소스의 기억을 품은 돌이라면 어떤 돌이든 저희를 그곳으로 보내줄 것입: Any stone holding Knossos's memories will send us there. To the village of our Kali people...
strings.(메디아가 땅에서 어떤 문양이 새겨진 돌을 주워 손에 올려놓는다. 그러자: (Medea picks up a stone engraved with a pattern and rests it in her hand. The stone holding Knossos's memories scatters like dust and carries them away.)
I wondered whether it would work. We really made it.
strings.…저기, 메디아 님? 그 말씀은 칼리로 오지 못했을 수도 있다는 말씀이잖: ...Lady Medea? That means we might not have reached Kali.
strings.그런데, 수인왕과 이야기는 잘 나누셨어요?: Did your conversation with the beastman king go well?
strings.미노스 님과 이야기를 하다 보니 크노소스에 알 수 없는 믿음이 생겼습니다: Speaking with Lord Minos gave me a curious sense of faith in Knossos.
strings.이제 말씀드릴 수 있게 됐네요. 그곳에서 그의 이야기를 했다간 저희도 나: Now I can tell you. Had we discussed him there, we might not have been able to leave either...
Knossos as it is now could be called that man himself... In any case...
strings.그는 신을 따르는 자를 죽인 자입니다. 그리고 자신과 같은 존재들이 신이: He killed someone who followed a god. And he wants beings like himself to stand above the humans the gods love.
Long ago, that woman told me...
strings.신을 따르던 동생을 죽이고 스스로 어떤 땅의 관리자가 되어 그 땅을 삼킨: There was an older brother who killed his god-following younger brother, made himself caretaker of a land, and swallowed that land...
The older brother's name was Daedalus... The one now called Talos...
strings.그가 무슨 꿍꿍이를 가지고 있는지는 알 수 없지만, 그분과 거래를 한 것: I do not know what he is planning, but he seems to have made a bargain with her.
Perhaps that bargain is what brought certain people from Knossos to Kali...
strings.정확히는 모릅니다. 다만…. 이건 저의 일, %s 당신이 모르셔도 되는: I don't know for certain. But... This is my concern, %s, something you need not know. Continue to focus on what stands in Lady Iris's way.
And I believe we will need to go to Debora soon.
strings.때가 되면 이리스 님께서도 알려주실 것 같군요. %s, 아발론의 일이 끝: Lady Iris will probably tell you when the time comes. %s, even after Avalon, your work will not be finished.
I will help, so please visit often.
strings.아닙니다. 그러면 오늘은 칼리에서 쉬도록 하세요. 베이넌에게 이야기할 테: Not at all. Rest in Kali today. I'll speak to Beinan... Have a meal, too.
I will. Thank you, Lady Medea.
Go to Merimel. She will show you somewhere to rest.
strings.(%s가 메리멜이 있는 곳으로 향하자 혼자 남은 메디아가 조용히 하늘을: (As %s heads toward Merimel, Medea, left alone, quietly looks up at the sky.)
strings.제 선택은 틀리지 않았습니다. 후회하지 않으니까요. 그리고 그 사람의 장: My choice was not wrong. I do not regret it. And I will stop that person's games.
